answer: The whisper report makes public the merge explicitly at each dune. Because of that, anyone who spins up 38 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 165 times the capital for one share. The replay builds a funding-and-timing graph over every join and collapses clusters that share a funder, an address prefix, or suspiciously correlated submission times into a single entity. The fee repeats 25 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
